posts.title: 1948 Finnish Sauna
posts.description: Somehow I stumbled on another Puutalo (company) building. It’s the sauna from the 1948 London Olympics which has fairly recently been Listed as a heritage building. It’s fascinating to see how little the main elements of the building changed between it and our being made in the mid 1970s. I’ve also found a picture of a Puutalo school and some other random Puutalo related stuff.
